subject: DI01005011

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Refrigeration removes heat from a lower-temperature region and rejects it to a higher-temperature sink using an appropriate work- or heat-driven process.

Classification / comparison

  • Methods in this syllabus: ice, evaporative, vapour compression, vapour absorption and steam-jet refrigeration.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Cooling is the intended effect; “creating cold”is not a separate energy substance. Acontinuous cyclic refrigerator must reject the extracted heat plus its net energy input.
  • Chemical plants refrigerate storage, condensation, separation and temperature-sensitive reactions; temperature, load, reliability and contamination risk govern selection.
  • Heat exchanger approach temperatures mean refrigerant evaporation is normally below the cooled stream and condensation above the sink; larger temperature lift tends to increase required input.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

નીચા temperature વાળા region માંથી heat કાઢીને work/heat-driven process થી higher-temperature sink માં reject કરવાનું refrigeration છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Syllabus methods: ice, evaporative, vapour compression, vapour absorption તથા steam-jet.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Cooling effect મળે છે; “cold બનાવવું”કોઈ અલગ substance નથી; cyclic refrigerator extracted heat તથા net input energy reject કરે છે.
  • Chemical plant માં storage, condensation, separation/temperature-sensitive reactions માટે refrigeration જોઈએ; T, load, reliability/contamination risk થી પસંદગી થાય.
  • Heat-transfer approach ને કારણે evaporation cooled stream થી નીચે તથા condensation sink થી ઉપર હોય; વધુ lift સામાન્ય રીતે input વધારે છે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Ice refrigeration uses the heat absorbed while ice warms and/or melts to cool another body or enclosed space.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • At ordinary pressure, pure ice melts near0°Cand absorbs latent heat without a temperature rise during ideal phase change. The ice must first be manufactured or obtained; its production energy is not free.
  • Insulation reduces heat gain; meltwater drainage/hygiene and separation from the product prevent contamination. Ordinary melting ice is not a controllable deep-freezing system.

Construction / parts

  1. Insulated chamber, ice compartment/rack, product space, air circulation paths and meltwater drain.

Working / process sequence

  1. Load an appropriate ice quantity and keep it separated from products needing hygienic protection.
  2. Heat enters the ice through air/wall contact and causes warming/melting.
  3. Remove meltwater hygienically and replenish ice when capacity is consumed.

Worked example

  1. With latent heat333.5kJ/kg supplied for the example, 10kgice melting at0°Cabsorbs3335kJ.If used over2h, average ideal cooling=3335/7200=0.4632kW, excluding losses and sensible heat.

Applications / uses

  • Short-duration transport, temporary cooling and selected food-storage services with verified hygiene.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Ice ગરમ થતી/પીગળતી વખતે heat absorb કરે તેનો ઉપયોગ કરીને body/space cool કરવું ice refrigeration છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Ordinary pressure પર pure ice લગભગ 0°C એ melt થઈ latent heat લે; ideal melting માં T વધતું નથી; ice manufacture ની energy free નથી.
  • Insulation heat gain ઘટાડે; drainage/hygiene/product separation contamination અટકાવે; ordinary ice deep-freezing system નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Insulated chamber, ice rack, product space, air paths તથા meltwater drain.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. યોગ્ય ice quantity મૂકી hygienic protection વાળા products થી અલગ રાખો.
  2. Air/wall contact થી heat ice માં જઈ warming/melting કરે.
  3. Meltwater hygienically કાઢો અને capacity પૂરી થતાં ice replace કરો.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. Given latent heat333.5kJ/kg થી 0°C પર 10kg ice3335kJ લે; 2h માં ideal average0.4632kW; loss/sensible heat નથી.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Short transport, temporary cooling/selected food storage, verified hygiene સાથે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Evaporative cooling uses latent heat taken from water/air when part of the water evaporates into an unsaturated air stream.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Direct evaporative cooling increases air humidity and reduces dry-bulb temperature toward its entering wet-bulb limit under the ideal assumptions; actual effectiveness is below the ideal limit.
  • Hot dry climates offer more cooling potential than humid climates because the dry-bulb/wet-bulb difference is larger. Water evaporation is not the same cycle as closed-loop VCR.
  • Water quality, drift, scaling and microbial control are needed; the label water-based does not make stagnant warm reservoirs safe.

Construction / parts

  1. Fan, wet pads/spray contactor, water reservoir/pump, distribution and drift control where required.

Working / process sequence

  1. Unsaturated air passes over wetted contact surfaces.
  2. Some water evaporates, absorbing latent heat and lowering air dry-bulb temperature.
  3. Recirculate treated water and remove concentrated salts as designed; maintain hygienic surfaces.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Effectiveness ε=(Tdb, in−Tdb, out)/(Tdb, in−Twb, in), when this direct-cooler definition and conditions apply.
  2. For40°CDB, 25°CWB, ε0.8: Tout=40−0.8(40−25)=28°C.This is not a promise of28°Cin every climate.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Unsaturated air માં પાણીનો ભાગ evaporate થાય ત્યારે water/air માંથી latent heat લેવાથી evaporative cooling થાય છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Direct evaporation air humidity વધારે અને dry-bulb ને entering wet-bulb limit તરફ ઘટાડે; actual effectiveness ideal કરતાં ઓછી છે.
  • Hot-dry climate માં DB/WB difference મોટો હોવાથી cooling potential વધારે; આ closed-loop VCR cycle નથી.
  • Water quality, drift, scale/microbial control જોઈએ; water-based નામથી stagnant warm reservoir safe નથી બનતો.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Fan, wet pads/spray contactor, reservoir/pump, distribution તથા required drift control.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Unsaturated air wet surfaces પરથી પસાર થાય.
  2. થોડું water evaporate થઈ latent heat લઈને air DB ઘટાડે.
  3. Treated water recirculate કરી designed salts control તથા hygienic surfaces રાખો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Applicable direct-cooler definition માં ε=(Tdb, in−Tdb, out)/(Tdb, in−Twb, in).
  2. DB40/WB25/ε0.8 હોય તો Tout28°C; દર climate માં 28°C ની guarantee નથી.

title.en: Vapour compression refrigeration: construction and cycle
title.gu: Vapour Compression Refrigeration: Construction તથા Cycle

h.en: Vapour compression refrigeration: construction and cycle
h.gu: Vapour Compression Refrigeration: Construction તથા Cycle

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A VCRsystem circulates a refrigerant through compression, condensation, throttling and evaporation to transfer heat using mechanical work.

Classification / comparison

  • Single-stage basic cycle is the syllabus model; real plants may use additional stages/control but are not all required as separate syllabus topics.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • The evaporator absorbs process heat at low pressure; the compressor raises vapour pressure; the condenser rejects heat at high pressure; the expansion device creates the pressure drop.
  • Throttling is approximately isenthalpic, h3≈h4, not isentropic and not a useful work-output process. Liquid carryover into a vapour compressor can cause damage.
  • Real cycles involve superheat, subcooling, pressure loss and nonideal compressor efficiency. The ideal diagram is a learning model, not a performance guarantee.

Construction / parts

  1. Evaporator: refrigerant/process heat exchanger with separated streams.
  2. Compressor: vapour inlet, drive/compression mechanism and oil management as applicable.
  3. Condenser: air/water-cooled heat exchanger that rejects the refrigeration load plus input.
  4. Expansion valve/capillary: meters liquid and drops pressure; receiver, filter-drier and controls support the selected design.

Working / process sequence

  1. 1→2: compress low-pressure vapour to higher pressure/enthalpy.
  2. 2→3: desuperheat/condense at the high side and optionally subcool.
  3. 3→4: throttle liquid to a low-pressure mixture at approximately constant enthalpy.
  4. 4→1: evaporate by absorbing heat; control outlet condition to suit the compressor/system.

Applications / uses

  • Process chillers, cold stores and controlled low-temperature duties within refrigerant/equipment limits.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • No opening, charging or venting refrigerant circuits by students. Pressure, electricity, flammability and toxic/asphyxiant hazards depend on refrigerant.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

VCR માં mechanical work થી heat transfer કરવા refrigerant compression, condensation, throttling તથા evaporation માંથી circulate થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Basic single-stage syllabus model છે; real plant માં additional stages/control હોય તો પણ બધા extra syllabus topics નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Evaporator low-pressure પર heat લે, compressor vapour pressure વધારે, condenser high-pressure પર heat reject કરે અને expansion device pressure drop બનાવે.
  • Throttling માં h3≈h4 છે, isentropic નથી અને useful work output આપતું નથી; compressor માં liquid carryover damage કરે.
  • Real cycle માં superheat, subcooling, pressure loss/nonideal efficiency હોય; ideal diagram guarantee નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Evaporator: separated refrigerant/process heat exchanger.
  2. Compressor: vapour inlet, drive/mechanism તથા applicable oil management.
  3. Condenser: air/water cooled exchanger જે cooling load તથા input heat reject કરે.
  4. Expansion valve/capillary liquid meter/pressure drop કરે; receiver, filter-drier/control design support કરે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. 1→2: low-pressure vapour નું pressure/enthalpy વધારે.
  2. 2→3: high side પર desuperheat/condense તથા optional subcool.
  3. 3→4: liquid ને લગભગ constant enthalpy થી low-pressure mixture બનાવે.
  4. 4→1: heat absorb કરીને evaporate કરે; outlet compressor/system માટે control કરે.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Refrigerant/equipment limits માં process chillers, cold stores/low-temperature duty.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Student circuit opening/charging/venting નહીં; pressure, electricity, flammability/toxicity/asphyxiation hazards refrigerant મુજબ છે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A vapour absorption system replaces most mechanical vapour-compression duty with absorption, liquid pumping and heat-driven refrigerant separation.

Classification / comparison

  • Working pairs: ammonia–water and water–LiBr; the same word strong/weak solution must specify whether it refers to refrigerant or absorbent concentration.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Refrigerant absorbs heat in the evaporator; absorbent takes up its vapour in the absorber, which must reject heat. The solution pump handles liquid, so its work can be much smaller than vapour-compressor work.
  • Heat in the generator releases refrigerant from solution; condenser/expansion/evaporator remain necessary. Absorption is heat-driven, not energy-input-free.
  • Ammonia–water: ammonia is refrigerant, water is absorbent; analyser/rectifier controls water carryover. LiBr–water: water is refrigerant, LiBris absorbent; vacuum and crystallisation limits matter.
  • Water-refrigerant systems are not suitable for ordinary subzero evaporation because water freezes; select the pair by required temperature and safety.

Construction / parts

  1. Evaporator, absorber, solution pump, generator, condenser, refrigerant expansion and solution pressure-reduction path; solution exchanger and rectification where applicable.

Working / process sequence

  1. Evaporated refrigerant enters absorber and dissolves in/joins the absorbent with heat rejection.
  2. Pump sends the liquid solution to generator pressure; heat drives refrigerant separation.
  3. Refrigerant condenses, throttles and evaporates to create cooling.
  4. The depleted solution returns through pressure reduction to absorber; restore concentration and heat balance without mixing the two return paths.

Applications / uses

  • Useful where suitable waste heat/steam and cooling-water conditions justify the larger heat-rejection/control system.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Vapour absorption માં મોટાભાગના mechanical vapour compression ની જગ્યાએ absorption, liquid pumping તથા heat-driven refrigerant separation થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Pairs: NH3-water તથા water-LiBr; strong/weak solution બોલતાં refrigerant કે absorbent concentration છે તે જણાવો.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Evaporator માં refrigerant heat લે; absorber vapour absorb કરી heat reject કરે; liquid pump નું work vapour compressor થી ઘણું ઓછું હોઈ શકે.
  • Generator heat થી solution માંથી refrigerant છોડાવે; condenser/expansion/evaporator જરૂરી રહે; heat-driven એટલે energy-free નહીં.
  • Ammonia-water માં NH3 refrigerant/water absorbent તથા rectifier water carryover control કરે; LiBr-water માં water refrigerant/LiBr absorbent, vacuum/crystallisation limits મહત્વનાં છે.
  • Water-refrigerant system ordinary subzero evaporation માટે યોગ્ય નથી; pair temperature/safety થી પસંદ કરો.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Evaporator, absorber, pump, generator, condenser, refrigerant expansion/solution reduction તથા applicable solution exchanger/rectifier.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Refrigerant vapour absorber માં absorbent સાથે મળે અને heat reject થાય.
  2. Pump solution ને generator pressure એ મોકલે; heat refrigerant અલગ કરે.
  3. Refrigerant condense/throttle/evaporate થઈ cooling આપે.
  4. Depleted solution pressure-reduction થી absorber માં પાછું આવે; બંને return paths ન ગૂંચવો.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Suitable waste heat/steam તથા cooling-water ઉપલબ્ધ હોય અને heat rejection/control યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A steam-jet refrigeration system uses a high-velocity motive-steam ejector to maintain low pressure so part of water evaporates and cools the remaining water.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • In the flash chamber, water boils at the saturation temperature corresponding to the vacuum; latent heat is supplied from the remaining water/load.
  • The ejector entrains low-pressure vapour, mixes it with motive steam and raises discharge pressure through momentum transfer/diffusion. The condenser removes this combined vapour load.
  • Vacuum leakage, cooling-water temperature, motive-steam condition and condenser pressure strongly affect capacity. Water as refrigerant limits below-freezing applications.

Construction / parts

  1. Flash chamber/water circuit, ejector nozzle, mixing section, diffuser, condenser, condensate removal and noncondensable extraction.

Working / process sequence

  1. Motive steam expands through nozzle and entrains chamber vapour.
  2. Chamber pressure falls; part of water flashes and cools the remaining water.
  3. Mixed vapour passes through diffuser to condenser; heat is rejected and noncondensables are removed by the designed system.
  4. Chilled water circulates to the load while water/condensate balance is maintained.

Applications / uses

  • Suitable chilled-water duties with adequate motive steam and condenser/vacuum conditions; not a universal high-efficiency substitute for VCR.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Motive steam ના high-velocity ejector થી low pressure બનાવી water નો થોડો ભાગ evaporate કરાવી બાકી water ઠંડું કરતું steam-jet refrigeration છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Flash chamber માં vacuum ને અનુરૂપ saturation T પર water boil થાય; latent heat remaining water/load માંથી આવે.
  • Ejector low-pressure vapour entrain/mix કરીને momentum transfer/diffusion થી discharge pressure વધારે; condenser combined load કાઢે.
  • Vacuum leakage, cooling-water T, motive-steam condition/condenser pressure capacity ને અસર કરે; water refrigerant હોવાથી below-freezing limits છે.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Flash chamber/water circuit, ejector nozzle, mixing section, diffuser, condenser, condensate removal/noncondensable extraction.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Motive steam nozzle માં expand થઈ chamber vapour ખેંચે.
  2. Chamber pressure ઘટતાં water નો ભાગ flash થઈ બાકીને ઠંડું કરે.
  3. Mixed vapour diffuser થી condenser માં જાય; heat/noncondensables designed system થી દૂર થાય.
  4. Chilled water load તરફ circulate થાય અને water/condensate balance જાળવાય.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Adequate steam/condenser-vacuum વાળી chilled-water duty; VCR નો universal high-efficiency substitute નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Refrigerator COPis the desired refrigeration effect divided by the specified required energy input; tonne of refrigeration is a unit of cooling RATE, not stored cooling or refrigerant mass.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • For a work-driven refrigerator, COPR=QL/W; for a heat-driven absorption convention, COP≈QL/Qgeneratorwhen pump work is neglected. State the chosen boundary.
  • COPcan exceed1because heat is moved, not created from work alone. It is not an efficiency percentage that must stay below100%.
  • 1TR≈3.517kW≈211kJ/min, conventionally based on melting one short ton of ice per24h. Use the declared rounded conversion consistently.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Steady cyclic energy balance gives QH=QL+W; hence COPR=QL/(QH−QL).
  2. For an ideal reversible refrigerator operating between constant reservoir temperatures, entropy balance gives QL/TL=QH/TH.
  3. Eliminate QHto obtain COPCarnot=TL/(TH−TL), with temperatures in kelvin; it is an upper-bound context, not a separate required syllabus cycle.

Worked example

  1. A10TRunit supplies35.17kWcooling; if electrical input is10kW, COP=3.517at that declared boundary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Refrigerator COP desired cooling effect/specified energy input છે; tonne of refrigeration cooling RATE નું unit છે, stored cooling કે refrigerant mass નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Work-driven માં COP=QL/W; heat-driven absorption માં pump work neglect થાય તો≈QL/Qgenerator; boundary સ્પષ્ટ કરો.
  • Heat move થતી હોવાથી COP1 થી વધુ હોઈ શકે; તે 100%થી ઓછી જ રહેવી પડે તેવી efficiency percentage નથી.
  • 1TR≈3.517kW≈211kJ/min; convention one short ton ice/24h પર આધારિત છે; એક જ rounded conversion વાપરો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Cyclic balance QH=QL+W થી COPR=QL/(QH−QL).
  2. Constant reservoirs વચ્ચે reversible system માં entropy balance QL/TL=QH/TH.
  3. QH eliminate કરતાં COPCarnot=TL/(TH−TL); T kelvin માં; આ upper-bound context છે, extra compulsory cycle નહીં.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. 10TR થી 35.17kW cooling અને input10kW હોય તો declared boundary પર COP3.517.

title.en: Refrigerants: primary, secondary and chemical families
title.gu: Refrigerants: Primary, Secondary તથા Chemical Families

h.en: Refrigerants: primary, secondary and chemical families
h.gu: Refrigerants: Primary, Secondary તથા Chemical Families

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A primary refrigerant circulates in the refrigeration cycle to absorb/reject heat; a secondary refrigerant or coolant carries cooling between that plant and the load without necessarily undergoing that primary cycle.

Classification / comparison

  • Primary: halocarbons, azeotropic blends, hydrocarbons, inorganic and unsaturated organic examples; secondary: water and brines. The mixture and chemistry axes are not mutually exclusive.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Water and brines are common secondary coolants; water itself can be a PRIMARYrefrigerant in absorption/steam-jet systems. Classification depends on role, not substance name alone.
  • Halocarbons include CFC, HCFC, HFCand related families; Freon is a trade name, not a rigorous name for every refrigerant. Legacy R12/R22examples are not recommendations for new equipment.
  • Azeotropes have essentially constant-boiling mixture composition at their specified conditions; zeotropic contrast explains temperature glide and possible composition change. HFOsare unsaturated fluorinated organic refrigerants and also halocarbons, so syllabus categories can overlap.
  • Hydrocarbons include propane/isobutane and are flammable. Inorganic refrigerants include ammonia, CO2and water; each has different toxicity, pressure and temperature constraints.
  • Identification examples, not selection approvals: halocarbon R134a; historical azeotrope R502; hydrocarbons R290(propane)/R600a(isobutane); inorganics R717(ammonia), R744(CO2), R718(water); unsaturated HFO examples R1234yf/R1234ze.
  • Brines such as suitable sodium-chloride or calcium-chloride solutions depress freezing temperature but increase corrosion/viscosity concerns; concentration must suit the actual freeze curve/materials rather than “more salt is always better”.

Applications / uses

  • Secondary loops can reduce refrigerant charge at remote loads but add pumping power, approach-temperature loss and leak/material management.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Primary refrigerant refrigeration cycle માં heat absorb/reject કરે; secondary refrigerant/coolant plant થી load સુધી cooling પહોંચાડે અને primary cycle કરવું જરૂરી નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Primary: halocarbons, azeotropic blends, hydrocarbons, inorganic/unsaturated organic; secondary: water/brines; mixture તથા chemistry axes mutually exclusive નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Water/brine secondary coolants છે; absorption/steam-jet માં water PRIMARY refrigerant પણ છે; role પરથી classification થાય.
  • Halocarbons માં CFC/HCFC/HFC વગેરે આવે; Freon trade name છે, બધાં refrigerants નું scientific નામ નહીં; R12/R22 historical examples છે, new selection recommendation નહીં.
  • Azeotrope specified conditions માં constant-boiling composition ધરાવે; zeotropic mixtures માં glide/composition change સમજાય; HFO unsaturated fluorinated organic તથા halocarbon બંને હોઈ categories overlap કરે.
  • Hydrocarbons માં propane/isobutane flammable છે; inorganic માં ammonia, CO2/water છે અને toxicity/pressure/T limits જુદાં છે.
  • ઓળખ માટે examples, approval નહીં: halocarbon R134a; historical azeotrope R502; HC R290(propane)/R600a(isobutane); inorganic R717(NH3), R744(CO2), R718(water); HFO R1234yf/R1234ze.
  • Suitable NaCl/CaCl2 brine freezing T ઘટાડે પણ corrosion/viscosity વધારી શકે; concentration actual freeze curve/materials થી પસંદ કરો, “વધુ salt હંમેશા સારું”નહીં.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Secondary loop remote load માં primary charge ઘટાડે પણ pumping, approach-temperature loss/leak-material management વધારે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

An ideal refrigerant would combine good cycle performance, safe handling, material compatibility and low environmental impact; real choices require trade-offs and compliance.

Classification / comparison

  • Thermodynamic; safe-working; physical/chemical; environmental and practical selection factors.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Thermodynamic: high useful refrigerating effect, appropriate saturation pressures/critical temperature, manageable pressure ratio and low discharge temperature for the required duty.
  • Physical: good heat transfer, manageable viscosity, adequate vapour density, chemical stability and compatible oil/material behaviour. Noncorrosive under all possible moisture conditions cannot be assumed.
  • Safety: toxicity, flammability, asphyxiation, leak detection and decomposition products; environment: ozone depletion, climate impact and indirect energy emissions.
  • Zero ODPdoes not imply low GWP, and low GWPdoes not imply nonflammability. CO2needs suitable high-pressure design; ammonia toxicity and hydrocarbon flammability require engineered safeguards.
  • Select required temperature/load first, then compatible equipment, performance, site safety, environmental/regulatory suitability, availability and service competence. Never retrofit by replacing only the fluid.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Ideal refrigerant માં good performance, safe handling, material compatibility તથા low environmental impact એક સાથે હોય; actual selection trade-offs/compliance થી થાય.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Thermodynamic; safe-working; physical/chemical; environmental તથા practical factors.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Thermodynamic: high refrigerating effect, suitable pressures/critical T, manageable pressure ratio તથા discharge T.
  • Physical: good heat transfer, manageable viscosity, vapour density, stability તથા oil/material compatibility; દર moisture condition માં noncorrosive છે એવું ન માનો.
  • Safety: toxicity, flammability, asphyxiation, leak detection/decomposition; environment: ODP, GWP તથા indirect energy emissions.
  • Zero ODP એટલે low GWP નહીં; low GWP એટલે nonflammable નહીં; CO2 માટે high-pressure design, NH3 toxicity/HC flammability માટે engineered safeguards જોઈએ.
  • પહેલાં T/load પછી compatible equipment, performance, site safety, environment/law, availability/service skill જુઓ; માત્ર fluid બદલી retrofit ન કરો.

title.gu: VCR Numerical: Cooling, COP તથા Condenser Load

h.gu: VCR Numerical: Cooling, COP તથા Condenser Load

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A refrigeration energy balance relates evaporator heat, compressor input and condenser rejection using the SAMEcycle state definitions.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Use kJ/kgwith kg/sto obtain kW; do not divide cooling by condenser heat and call that COP.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Assume steady flow, negligible kinetic/potential effects, adiabatic compressor and no line losses: h1=400, h2=440, h3=250, h4=250kJ/kg.
  2. Specific refrigerating effect qL=h1−h4=150kJ/kg; compressor work w=h2−h1=40kJ/kg.
  3. COP=qL/w=3.75.At refrigerant flow0.2kg/s, QL=30kWand input=8kW.
  4. Condenser rejection QH=0.2(h2−h3)=38kW=QL+W.
  5. Using1TR=3.517kW, capacity=30/3.517=8.530TR.The result is calculated, not a measured chiller test.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

એક જ cycle-state definitions થી evaporator heat, compressor input તથા condenser rejection જોડતું refrigeration energy balance છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • kJ/kg×kg/s થી kW મળે; cooling ને condenser heat થી divide કરીને COP ન કહો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Steady flow, negligible KE/PE, adiabatic compressor/no line loss સાથે h1=400, h2=440, h3=h4=250kJ/kg લો.
  2. qL=h1−h4=150kJ/kg અને w=h2−h1=40kJ/kg.
  3. COP3.75; flow0.2kg/s થી cooling30kW/input8kW.
  4. Condenser rejection0.2×190=38kW=30+8.
  5. 1TR3.517kW થી capacity8.530TR; આ calculated છે, measured chiller test નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A worked classroom calculation uses explicitly stated assumptions and computed values, not fabricated plant readings.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Assume absorption cooling QL70kW, generator heat100kWand negligible pump work. COPheat=70/100=0.70.
  2. Combined heat rejection from condenser PLUSabsorber≈70+100=170kW; do not assign the entire170kWto condenser alone.
  3. Cooling capacity=70/3.517≈19.90TR; this is heat-driven COP, not directly the same electrical boundary as a compressor-only VCRcomparison.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Classroom calculation stated assumptions/computed values વાપરે છે, બનાવટી plant readings નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Absorption QL70kW/generator100kW તથા negligible pump work હોય તો COP0.70.
  2. Condenser PLUS absorber total rejection≈170kW; આખું 170 માત્ર condenser ને ન આપો.
  3. Capacity70/3.517≈19.90TR; આ heat-driven COP છે, VCR compressor-only electrical boundary સાથે સીધી સરખામણી નહીં.
QL=m(h1−h4); W=m(h2−h1); QH=QL+W. સંબંધિત assumptions/સમજણ માટે Notes જુઓ.

body.en: Work-driven COP=QL/W; heat-driven COP≈QL/Qgeneratorwhen pump work neglected.
body.gu: Work-driven COP=QL/W; heat-driven COP≈QL/Qgeneratorwhen pump work neglected. સંબંધિત assumptions/સમજણ માટે Notes જુઓ.
1TR≈3.517kW≈211kJ/min, cooling RATE. સંબંધિત assumptions/સમજણ માટે Notes જુઓ.
ε=(Tdb, in−Tdb, out)/(Tdb, in−Twb, in). સંબંધિત assumptions/સમજણ માટે Notes જુઓ.

a.en: Heat naturally flows hot to cold; refrigeration moves heat from a colder region to a warmer sink with suitable input. It cannot operate cyclically without rejecting heat.
a.gu: Natural heat hot થી cold જાય; refrigeration input થી cold થી warm heat મોકલે; heat rejection વગર cyclic operation નહીં.

a.en: The input helps MOVEheat, so cooling effect can exceed work input. Energy is conserved because sink rejection includes both cooling heat and work.
a.gu: Input heat MOVE કરે; એટલે cooling work થી વધુ હોઈ શકે; sink માં cooling+work reject થાય એટલે conservation યથાવત્.

a.en: No. It is cooling rate, about3.517kW.The abbreviation does not specify circulating mass or stored ice quantity.
a.gu: નહીં. તે cooling rate લગભગ 3.517kW છે; circulating mass/stored ice નથી.

a.en: Basic throttling produces no shaft work and is approximately isenthalpic. It is not the ideal isentropic expansion of a turbine.
a.gu: Basic throttling shaft work આપતું નથી અને h લગભગ constant છે; તુરબાઇન જેવી isentropic expansion નથી.

a.en: Generator heat is substantial input; solution pump work may be relatively small. Absorber ANDcondenser reject heat, so heat-source quality and rejection conditions matter.
a.gu: Generator heat મોટો input છે; pump work ઓછું હોઈ શકે; absorber અને condenser બંને heat reject કરે.

a.en: For direct cooling, the entering wet-bulb temperature is the ideal approach limit under the stated model. High humidity reduces the available dry-bulb depression.
a.gu: Direct model માં entering wet-bulb ideal approach limit છે; high humidity થી DB reduction ઓછું મળે.

q.en: Can water be a primary refrigerant?

a.en: Yes, in suitable absorption or steam-jet systems. It is also a secondary coolant in other plants, so classification is based on role.
a.gu: હા, suitable absorption/steam-jet માં; બીજા plant માં secondary coolant પણ છે એટલે role થી classification થાય.

a.en: No. Flammability, toxicity, pressure and material compatibility remain separate issues. Never select/retrofit on environmental score alone.
a.gu: નહીં. Flammability, toxicity, pressure/material compatibility અલગ છે; માત્ર environmental score થી selection/retrofit નહીં.
